# Skyexchange7

> India's premium online cricket and casino playground — WhatsApp ID in 60 seconds, sub-2-second IPL odds, UPI deposits and 5-minute INR withdrawals, backed by 24×7 human support.

Skyexchange7 (skyexchange7.live) is an INR-first sports gaming and live casino platform for Indian players. We cover live cricket markets (IPL, T20 World Cup, ODI, Test), Indian card games (Andar Bahar, Teen Patti, Lucky 7), crash games (Aviator), live dealer tables (Roulette, Baccarat, Dragon Tiger) and 1000+ slot titles. Onboarding, deposits and withdrawals happen over WhatsApp + UPI.
